+        def mappick_sql(self, expression: exp.MapPick) -> str:
+            keys = expression.expressions
+            x_dot_key = exp.Dot(this=exp.to_identifier("x"), expression=exp.to_identifier("key"))
+
+            is_key_array = len(keys) == 1 and (
+                isinstance(keys[0], exp.Array) or keys[0].is_type(exp.DType.ARRAY)

+                predicate = exp.func("ARRAY_CONTAINS", keys[0], x_dot_key)
+            else:
+                predicate = exp.In(this=x_dot_key, expressions=keys)
+

+                exp.ArrayFilter(this=exp.func("MAP_ENTRIES", expression.this), expression=lambda_expr),
